summary: Iteration 204 tested line receipts, long texts (3 joined parts) and the code-split landing. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed. Receipts API: the eSIM es_a52441cc7f4f returns Purchase + Renewal at $75, newest first, with all fields. The mobile mn_b5893a901b4f returns 1 Purchase and no texts. Without a login it returns 401. Bob and a bad id get 'Line not found.' Parts are 1/2/2/3/3 at 160/161/306/307/459 characters. 460 → 'Keep it to 459 characters (3 joined texts)' on both the mobile and Business numbers. Emoji 202 → 'Keep it to 201'. The thread maxLength is 459. A 300-character send from the USA mobile number took $0.10 from the wallet (transaction amount 0.1, metadata.parts 2, phoneLog charge 0.1). The 300-character Business send returned sms_blocked (10DLC), not a length error. Saving the IVR with 400 characters works; 500 → 'Key 3: Keep it to 459'. The IVR was restored afterwards. Frontend: receipts toggle, list, hide and print work on /esim and on /numbers mobile cards; the print popup opens with the receipt HTML and no errors. The composer count, cost, red state and send-disabled are exactly as specified at 160/161/306/307/459/460 and for emoji 70/71/201/202. The calling-number thread shows 'Uses 2/3 plan texts (1 per part)…'. A 200-character UI send took $0.10 (249.63→249.53). The IVR counter shows parts and per-press cost, with a red border at 460. /cloudivr renders at 390 (no overflow) and 1920 with no i18n chunk. /cloudivr/terms, /cloudivr/admin login, root '/' Nomadly dashboard and /panel login all render translated text; the i18n chunk loads only for non-CloudIVR pages. The app deep link redirects to login and the Shell loads after sign-in. No chunk or page errors; the only console errors are the expected unauthenticated 401s.

minor.issue: The overage check is all-or-nothing. If a plan has 1 text left and the message is 3 parts, isSmsLimitReached is false, so no overage is charged. All 3 parts are still added to the used count, so 2 parts go out for free. It should charge for each part beyond what is left in the plan.

ui_bugs.issue: <Receipts> sits inside the flex-wrap action-button row. When it opens, the receipts list widens that flex item, which pushes 'Cancel eSIM' / 'Cancel number' far to the right with a large gap, and the list hangs under the Receipts button instead of spanning the card. Fix: render the list outside the button row (lift the open state up, or make the list basis-full / a separate block).

design_issues.screen: Composer / IVR counter when over the limit
issues: At 460+ characters it still shows '$0.20 from your wallet · 4 parts × $0.05' for a text that can't be sent. Hide the cost or say 'too long' instead.

design_issues.screen: /panel login (likely pre-existing, CSS not changed this iteration)
issues: At 1920 the card is left-aligned (x≈20) and leaves a big empty area. .panel-login-page is display:grid with 1fr columns and the card has no justify-self/margin:auto.

action_items: Move the receipts list out of the action-button flex row in Esim.js and MobileLines.js so it spans the card and doesn't shove the Cancel button
sms-reply.js: charge overage for each part beyond the remaining plan texts, not all-or-nothing
Optional: hide the cost line when the text is over 3 parts; useBalance in Composer checks only one part (t.cost.each), not each*parts
critical_code_review_comments: Composer useBalance(t.cost.each) lets a user with $0.05–0.14 compose a 3-part text; the server then rejects it with 'wallet needs $0.15'. Acceptable, but the gate could use each*parts.
receiptsOf matches metadata.lineId only. Older purchases saved without lineId in metadata will not appear (seeded data was fine).
printReceipt uses window.open with 'noopener=no' plus document.write. It works, but if a popup blocker stops it, it returns silently with no message to the user.
